title: Filtering the Noise
speaker: Pastor Mike Roth
description: In our noisy world filled with competing voices, Jesus offers clarity through the imagery of the Good Shepherd in John 10. Unlike thieves and robbers who steal, kill, and destroy, Jesus leads us to abundant life through protection and provision. The false shepherds in our lives - workaholism, fear, materialism, and anxiety - promise fulfillment but leave us empty. Jesus calls Himself both the Good Shepherd who knows our voice and the gate who protects us from harm while leading us to green pastures. True abundance isn't about having more stuff, but about experiencing quality of life through deep connection with our Creator. Learning to recognize His voice requires intentionally filtering life's noise and trusting His way rather than trying to find security through our own efforts.
